title: [Peek] Add CLI support for previewing multiple files/folders. Fix multiple CLI issues

proposed_comments.title: Preserve CLI folder display names (1/2)
proposed_comments.body:
### (1/2) Preserve CLI folder display names

**Severity:** `medium`

An existing directory argument can retain its trailing separator, but `Path.GetFileName` returns an empty string for paths such as `C:\photos\`. The resulting `FolderItem` then has a blank title and preview name. Route display-name derivation through the normalized helper below, and apply both grouped suggestions together.

```suggestion
                string name = GetDisplayName(path);
```

confidence.rationale: The exact current code passes trailing-separator directory paths to Path.GetFileName, which returns empty; the grouped literal patch built independently and in combination and passed controlled folder, root, and file cases.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve CLI folder display names (2/2)

confidence.rationale: The fallback is required for roots; the exact helper was compiled and invoked against C:\photos\, C:\, and C:\photo.jpg with the expected results.

proposed_comments.title: Track multi-selection separately from navigation (1/5)
proposed_comments.body:
### (1/5) Track multi-selection separately from navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

For a single Explorer selection, `Items` intentionally contains neighboring folder entries for navigation, so its count is not the number of selected files. Add a separate observable activation flag and apply all five grouped suggestions together.

```suggestion
        private IReadOnlyList<IFileSystemItem>? _items;

        [ObservableProperty]
        [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(HasMultipleItems))]
        private bool _isMultipleItemsActivation;
```

confidence.rationale: NeighboringItemsQuery deliberately loads folder neighbors for ordinary Explorer activation; a dedicated flag is needed to preserve selection semantics.

proposed_comments.title: Track multi-selection separately from navigation (2/5)

confidence.rationale: The resource defines the count as selected files, while Items includes navigation neighbors; the exact replacement restores that distinction.

proposed_comments.title: Track multi-selection separately from navigation (3/5)
proposed_comments.body:
### (3/5) Track multi-selection separately from navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

For Explorer activation, use the query's existing selection-mode result after loading the neighboring items.

```suggestion
            CurrentItem = (Items != null && Items.Count > 0) ? Items[0] : null;
            IsMultipleItemsActivation = NeighboringItemsQuery.IsMultipleFilesActivation;
```

confidence.rationale: NeighboringItemsQuery already exposes IsMultipleFilesActivation, which directly distinguishes multi-selection from single-selection navigation.

proposed_comments.title: Track multi-selection separately from navigation (4/5)
proposed_comments.body:
### (4/5) Track multi-selection separately from navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

CLI activation already receives the complete selected path list, so derive the flag directly from that list before creating preview items.

```suggestion
            _currentIndex = DisplayIndex = 0;
            IsMultipleItemsActivation = paths.Count > 1;
```

confidence.rationale: The CLI path list is the activation selection itself; controlled checks covered both single- and multi-path cases.

proposed_comments.title: Track multi-selection separately from navigation (5/5)
proposed_comments.body:
### (5/5) Track multi-selection separately from navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

Reset the activation flag with the item collection so a later initialization cannot observe stale counter state.

```suggestion
            Items = null;
            IsMultipleItemsActivation = false;
```

confidence.rationale: The exact candidate resets this state during Uninitialize, and the controlled truth-table check verified the reset case.
